abilities.effect: Sidesteps toward noticed food using the same march locomotion.
abilities.name: Seek
abilities.trigger: Plant inside 2.8 m wide notice cone (65°)

abilities.effect: 7 damage per hit every 1.0 s while holding outside the wall (reach 1.3 m).
abilities.name: Siege

clipAnnotations.attack: Chomp loop: 1 plant bite per 0.5 s, 1 house hit per 1.0 s.
clipAnnotations.walk: March/seek locomotion toward the pearl or noticed food.

lore: Starved wanderers drawn to the Pearl's light. They nibble the nearest plant first.
mechanism: Basic enemy with two-stage appetite: NOTICE plants in a wide 65°/2.8 m cone, SEEK (sidestep toward) them, and EAT only what ends up in the narrow 30°/1.8 m frontal cone. Ignores plants otherwise and marches down its lane toward the Sacred Dragon Pearl, sieging the dais wall from outside (1.3 m reach clears the 1.06 m eat lunge).
name: Hungry Ghost
